g.data-name: stat_label · This machine's health, checked while it

g.text: This machine's health, checked while it runs, and what it has told home: crashes, freezes, failed checks and your reports. Report a problem here.

g.data-name: stat_label · Reporting is on by default for developme

g.text: Reporting is on by default for development and beta builds. Nothing waiting.

g.data-name: stat_label · The live checks run a minute after start

g.text: The live checks run a minute after start and every few minutes after that. Run all checks to add the install's.

g.data-name: stat_label · Say what you saw and when: which screen,

g.text: Say what you saw and when: which screen, what it did, what you had just pressed. It goes home with this machine's logs and a fresh check of everything.
e.g. Screen B went black for a few seconds right after the queue alert, about 2:15.
